race.comment: Onto the Caulfield Guineas and again we're looking for a bit of value in he form of TRON BOLT (4) who is already a G1 winner over a mile in the JJ Atkins. His two runs back have been more than enough, given no chance fresh then holding his ground in a brutally run Golden Rose second up. He was at his top throughout there, the step to a mile can see him improve lengths and this has been his grand final all along. WARWOVEN (2) won the Golden Rose brilliantly and smashed the clock in doing so. Can't see a mile posing an issue off that but it was a huge spike, perhaps he regresses just a touch. Regardless, he's the one to beat. Very wary of BLIND RAISE (5) who was dominant winning the Prelude, working early then attacked on the turn but putting a gap on them late. He'll be on speed and run this out strongly. CENTRAL EUROPE (7) went way too fast in the Golden Rose and could improve from DIAMETER (6) who won the Stutt Stakes, albeit that looks the inferior form line.
